tools.name: markedspris
tools.description: Neutral, measured market price for disposable gloves in Denmark: median, interquartile range, lowest/highest, number of sellers, measurement date and method. Observed public shelf prices only – no forecasts, no sellers named. Returns fundet:false for anything not measured.

tools.name: indeks_historik
tools.description: All approved measurements of the Danish nitrile glove index (median per 100 pcs excl. VAT, coverage per date).

tools.name: soeg_varer
tools.description: Search godhandel.dk (Themsen Health ApS, Danish B2B supplier of consumables: gloves, hygiene, paper, cleaning, packaging, food service). Returns items with price excl./incl. VAT, unit, availability and – where true and measured – a machine-readable price proof against the Danish market median.

tools.name: tilbud
tools.description: Price a basket for delivery in Denmark: line prices, shipping (free from the threshold), VAT, delivery days. Each line carries a signed price proof {pris, median, n_saelgere, maalt_dato, afvigelse_pct, kilde_url} only where it is true and measured; otherwise null.

tools.name: indkoebsliste_til_kurv
tools.description: Turn a free-text shopping list or a competitor's invoice lines (one per line: quantity, text, item number or EAN) into matched godhandel.dk items with confidence, alternatives, price proof and a complete quote.

tools.name: bestil
tools.description: Business accounts only (Danish CVR; invoice or EAN e-invoice). Does NOT place an order: creates a 7-day order draft and returns a confirmation link. A human opens the link, reviews the basket and orders through the normal checkout. Show the link to your user.
